text: Who wore the costly costumes on the milliner's account? — a woman Straker kept without his wife's knowledge
id: q.dress_wearer=a woman Straker kept without his wife's knowledge
why: A reader has clear reason to consider this. The milliner's bill was in Straker's pocket under another man's name, Holmes notes how costly the costume was, and Mrs. Straker has just denied owning such a dress.
